data.one_liner: A Flutter sliver that centers its child sliver within itself along the cross axis.
data.what_it_does: SliverCenter is a custom sliver widget designed to center a child sliver, such as a SliverList or SliverGrid, within the available space along the cross axis. It works within CustomScrollView and its sliver layout system to keep the child positioned in the center regardless of the parent's size.
use_when: You need to center a sliver like a SliverList or SliverGrid within its parent along the cross axis
You are building responsive layouts with CustomScrollView where slivers need to be centered on big screens
avoid_when: You are working with standard box widgets instead of slivers
You do not need cross-axis centering for your sliver content
strengths: Simple declarative syntax for centering slivers
weaknesses: Limited scope restricted strictly to sliver-based layouts
